Advance is for students around ages 15–18. AfroBot does not guarantee admission or scholarships.

Tell us how you want to take part.

This form is for adults. Parents and guardians, community leaders, mentors, and partners can write. A student takes part through a parent or guardian. We use this only to reply about AfroBot.

Fields marked *with an asterisk are required.

  • If you are under 18, ask a parent or guardian to submit this form.
  • Do not include a child’s full date of birth, school ID, or anything meant for a public profile.
  • Do not send financial documents, tax forms, or account numbers.
  • The interest list is not team placement.
